description: Starter eval set for the Open Context Engine repo itself. Run from the repo root: oce eval --cases eval/oce.eval.json. Each case is a natural-language query a developer (or agent) would actually issue, with the file(s) that must surface for the answer to be possible.

cases.query: where is reciprocal rank fusion implemented and how are vector and bm25 results combined
cases.notes: Core ranking algorithm; exact term appears in code.

cases.query: how are files excluded from indexing based on gitignore rules
voyage api embedding requests with batching and retry
sqlite table schema for chunks and the vector index
splitting code into chunks along function and class boundaries with tree-sitter
how are related chunks pulled in by following import and call edges at retrieval time
extracting import and inheritance edges from the syntax tree per language
cases.notes: New AST extractor — added after the regex replacement.

cases.query: agent tool that replaces an exact substring in a file with uniqueness check
offline license key signature verification with ed25519
registering the codebase retrieval tool on the MCP server
debouncing rapid file change events before reindexing
expanding a search query with synonyms like delete remove destroy
merging nearby line ranges and dropping chunks over the character budget when formatting results
boosting recently committed files in search ranking using git log
limiting agent tool steps and detecting repeated identical tool calls
classifying NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch and glibc errors when the sqlite binding fails to load
cases.notes: Diagnostics added with the VSIX fix.

cases.query: detecting whether the index is stale compared to the working tree and git state
compacting old conversation messages when the token budget is exceeded
